Most souls give their essence freely, understanding they are contributing to a higher glory in their sacrifice. The Church of the Virtual Saints, however, is a lively religion and its hunger for essence is insatiable. The sacrifices alone are often never enough. Sometimes it is necessary to offer incentives to the scholastic, the studious, and the brainy. So we do.
